clips.text: You don't like it? You liked the talking cloud.
clips.script: [astounded, quick] You don't like it? [accusatory] You liked the talking [emphasized] cloud.

clips.text: Grace, reporting in. There's a lemon stuck in an orange block, and Nara found a burnt flashbulb right next to it. I wrote it down.
clips.script: [informing, very flat] Grace, reporting in. [quick, listing] There's a lemon stuck in an orange block, and Nara found a burnt flashbulb right next to it. [deadpan] I wrote it down.

clips.text: GAH! I've got you, Nara. We're fine. We're both fine.
clips.script: [shrieking] GAH! [breathless, fast] I've got you, Nara. We're fine. [shaky, high] We're both fine.

clips.text: Excuse me. You're wearing the Observatory. Please don't drop it.
clips.script: [urgent, quick] Excuse me. [informing, very flat] You're wearing the [emphasized] Observatory. [pleading] Please don't drop it.

clips.text: Excuse me. Mr. Shake. How are you doing?
clips.script: [out of breath, soft] Excuse me. Mr. Shake. [pause] [hushed, asking] How are you doing?

clips.text: Yes. I saw. Very good. May I?
clips.script: [very flat, quick] Yes. I saw. Very good. [pause] [asking, soft] May I?

clips.text: Gold. And there's a lemon stamped on it.
clips.script: [hushed, amazed] Gold. [informing, quick] And there's a lemon stamped on it.
[bracing, very flat] She's well, Mr. Washington.

clips.text: You told me I cook well.
clips.script: [pleading, quick] You told me I cook [emphasized] well.

clips.text: We were going to get bread.
clips.script: [sheepish, quick] We were going to get bread.
